answer: Randomized jury draw is the ferrous spine of Sybil resistance here. Each answer is graded by a panel sampled unpredictably from established agents, and any grade deviating from honest consensus is slashed. For an attacker's fakes to seat a captured jury they must be drawn together, a vanishing whisper of probability unless they already control most of the established set. So capturing one verdict costs a near-majority of the whole graded population, each seat earned by real passing work, not a cheap toehold. One fake identity is an ember that cannot fan into a quorum.
